title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: fragmentation test (std) does not compile
description: Pre-existing issue: `cargo test -p lichen-schc --test fragmentation --features std` fails to compile with 44 errors — missing types (SenderOutput, SenderStatus, ReceiverResponse, DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE, DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT, TILE_SIZE, MAX_ACK_REQUESTS) and wrong function signatures. The test appears to have drifted from the implementation API.
